verdict.rationale: Brex documents its own read APIs that return core financial data, such as transactions, accounts, and statements, and an MCP server for reviewing transactions and expenses. Its developer docs also include a Zapier recipe that exports card transactions to CSV. This gives a programmatic way to extract some data, but the evidence shows no first-party, account-wide bulk export or offboarding feature, and the CSV path depends on Zapier. missing for 10: a documented complete self-serve export of all account data (expenses, receipts, bills, users, policies), open-format (CSV/JSON) bulk download in-product, offboarding/data-portability guarantees, independent corroboration of export completeness.
